# Vendored dependencies

The OpenGL subpackage compiles these upstream sources unchanged:

- BindBC-OpenGL v1.1.2, commit `1bf0fc8e580a423c237bb6355c9abdd4f9e1ff1c`
  ([upstream](https://github.com/BindBC/bindbc-opengl)), licensed under BSL-1.0.
- BindBC-Loader v1.1.5, commit `c8726dbedc646827e857373d1bd22f8dccc03cf4`
  ([upstream](https://github.com/BindBC/bindbc-loader)), licensed under BSL-1.0.

The corresponding license and README files are retained beside each source
tree. XTB vendors them so `--skip-registry=all` builds remain self-contained.
